page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a narrow margin note column on the left. Running head across the top, page number at upper left. Below the main text, no notes.

main_text.p: bum Sanctorum reponere? O quàm vellent sanguinarij isti, nullum prorsus huius exempli (quo nihil in illorum machinationes barbaras, è tota sacra, vel profana Historia planiùs aut plenius erui potest) in divinis Codicibus vestigium vllibi extare; sed diuina prouidentia extat, & inuitis eorum ensibus, inuitis ignibus, ad rebellionis confusionem perpetuam, & coronam obedientiæ in æternum extabit: & sanctissimus Propheta Dauid exurget in iudicio cum secta hac, & condemnabit; qui illud non in ore solùm, sed in corde fixum habebat acroama, quod ego in omnium Christianorum linguis, cordibus, manibus, maiusculis characteribus altè incisum cuperem; NQLITE TANGERE CHRISTOS MEOS.
main_text.head: CAP. VIII.

head.i: De proditione Absolonis & Seba, & eorundem miserando exitu.

main_text.p: DAvide adhuc superstite Ammon eius primogenitus patriqve in guberna-z 2.Sam.13

page.notes: The paragraph ending "guberna-" is cut off at the foot of the page; the continuation "bernaculis" is on the next page. The Greek-looking "a" in "guberna-" is likely a printer's Cyrillic-like shape; I transcribed it as a Latin "a" with uncertainty. The left margin note "z 2.Sam.13" is partly blurred; the "z" may be a mark and is copied as seen. The running head "LIB. I." is read as part of the head line. The page number is printed at upper left. The reference mark "*" beside "Ammon" is left as printed in the text with no matching note. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
